Design system.

@proudindian/design: the Tailwind v4 theme, the .pi-* primitives, the React components, the brand doodles and the logo set. Everything on this page is rendered from the package.

colourtypespaceradiusshadowmotionlayoutcomponentsdoodleslogo

Colour

Roles (Tailwind: bg-*, text-*, border-*)

  • surface-sky var(--color-sky)
  • surface-paper var(--color-paper)
  • surface-paper-2 var(--color-paper-2)
  • surface-ink var(--color-ink)
  • surface-card var(--color-white)
  • surface-wash var(--color-sky-tint)
  • surface-deep var(--color-sky-ink)
  • on-sky var(--color-ink)
  • on-ink var(--color-paper)
  • on-ink-muted var(--color-paper-a82)
  • text-muted var(--color-mute)
  • accent-ink var(--color-sky-ink)
  • accent-on-ink var(--color-sky)
  • donate var(--color-marigold)
  • festival var(--color-marigold)
  • link var(--color-sky-ink)
  • focus var(--color-sky-deep)

Contrast is WCAG 2.x. Marigold is for donate actions and Kalakriti only. Never sky text on paper (1.87:1).

Type

Display: Bricolage Grotesque 800 (font-pi-display, family Brico). Text: Geist (font-pi-sans). No italics. Sizes are keyed by px: text-15 is 15px.
